fix_attempts.root_cause: Test-side seed bug: (a) running_balance was reset at the start of each month (`= 500 + month_offset * 10`), breaking cross-month continuity — opening(month N+1) != closing(month N). fix_attempts.fix_summary: Reduced to 28 rows/month (one per unique day) and replaced per-month reset with a per-pair cumulative `balance_by_pair` dict that persists across months. Total dataset is now 2016 rows (down from 4320) — still substantial; reliably satisfies the FORMULA-001 invariant on every (design, grade) read.
